newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan-US vice minister insurance talks set.
newsitem.headline: Japan-US vice minister insurance talks set.

text.p: Japan and the United States will hold vice ministerial-level talks on their bilateral insurance dispute on November 25 and 26 in Tokyo, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Wednesday.
Mitsuzuka said the date for ministerial level talks has not been set yet.
Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Japanese Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, will meet Ira Shapiro of the U.S. Trade Representative's office, Mitsuzuka told a news conference.
U.S. and Japanese negotiators held a round of talks in the United States last week on the issue of opening up Japan's insurance market.

Washington is pressing Tokyo to liberalise its primary insurance markets before a niche area called the "third sector", where U.S. firms have a strong foothold, is opened up to Japanese insurance companies.
